name: Akumu [Horror]
desc:
Today, we are starting to revamp the whole Akumu game with a new name and stories. 
I will appreciate your patience with a new major update. Join our community server to see more announcements soon!

A traditional folktale that deceived many into believing immortality was possible to achieve. A doomed man who instead summoned "Her". Venture into the woods and find out the horrifying truth to this folktale.

Join our community through the Social links

This game is inspired by The Mimic

Tags: Geisha, Samurai, Mimic, Horror, Survival, Ghost, Spirit, Evil, Scary, Multiplayer Horror, Monox
